visual_review.method: every page compared side by side with the source at 60 dpi with 70-200 dpi close-ups (cover patch, p20 operator equations); first-line baselines of every Korean block measured against the source on all pages (all within 1.0 pt except the cover title, which is display lettering on a gradient patch); edgecheck.py clean (the p20 photon-operator lines were retyped in KaTeX instead of split crops); check.py reports only full-width line-box artefacts beside stamps, the full-page stamps of the cover/blank/back-cover pages, and a KaTeX strut box on p20 (9.6) that extends past the margin without visible ink
